description:
Top-level `audit/` directory tracks 24 files (phase{0..4}_*.txt + status.md). The phase markers contain a few bytes each (e.g. `phase0_done.txt` is 5 bytes literally containing 'done\n'). These look like ephemeral workflow markers that escaped into git history.

`crate-jmap-chat-types/audit/` is a per-crate audit dir tracked separately (5 files) — leftover from before audits were centralized.

Either:
1. Move under `.beads/` (which already has its own state mgmt)
2. Add `audit/` to .gitignore and `git rm -r --cached audit/`
3. Delete entirely if the marker files have no current meaning

Same for crate-jmap-chat-types/audit/ — looks vestigial.

Don't bundle into the published tarball: cargo will currently include them (no exclude rule in Cargo.toml or .gitignore) since they're in the crate root for chat-types.
title: P2: audit/ directory tracked in git with phase-completion marker files
